#Functions
```{r}
#This is the main function used to extract all posterior samples from the 4 Markov chains
get_chains <- function(brmsmodel){
  chain.1 <- as.data.frame(as_draws(brmsmodel)[1]) %>% rename_all(~stringr::str_replace(.,"^X1.",""))
  chain.2 <- as.data.frame(as_draws(brmsmodel)[2]) %>% rename_all(~stringr::str_replace(.,"^X2.",""))
  chain.3 <- as.data.frame(as_draws(brmsmodel)[3]) %>% rename_all(~stringr::str_replace(.,"^X3.",""))
  chain.4 <- as.data.frame(as_draws(brmsmodel)[4]) %>% rename_all(~stringr::str_replace(.,"^X4.",""))

  chains <- suppressMessages(join_all(list(chain.1, chain.2, chain.3, chain.4), type = 'full'))
  return(chains)
}

invlogit <- function(x){return(1/(1 + exp(-x)))}
sigma_ZOIB <- function(mu, phi){return(sqrt((mu * (1 - mu))/(exp(phi) + 1)))}

sdlog <- function(m, s) sqrt(log(1 + (s^2 / m^2)))
meanlog <- function(m, s) log(m) - (sdlog(m, s)^2) / 2

bias <- function(x, theta){
  if (theta == 0){
    return(round(100 * mean(x, na.rm = TRUE), 3))
  } else {
    return(round(100 * (mean(x - theta, na.rm = TRUE))/theta, 3))
  }
}

mse <- function(x, theta){
  if (theta == 0){
    return(round(100 * (mean(x^2, na.rm = TRUE)), 3))
  } else {
    return(round(100 * mean((x - theta)^2, na.rm = TRUE)/theta^2, 3))
  }
}

mcse <- function(x, theta){
  if (theta == 0){
    return(round(100 * sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)/sqrt(n_rep), 3))
  } else {
    return(round(100 * sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)/(theta * sqrt(n_rep)), 3))
  }
}
```

#Preparing the Data
```{r}
#Reading in the raw data file from (Edelsbrunner et al., 2024)
analyticdata <- readRDS("data/analyticdata.rds")
alles <- analyticdata[[3]]
alles <- alles %>% mutate(class = paste0(teacher_id, student_grade_pre))
dat <- alles %>% select(c(student_id, Treatment4, class, gesamtscore_pre, gesamtscore_post))

#Renaming columns for our purposes
dat <- dat %>% dplyr::rename(
  id = student_id,
  cond = Treatment4,
  pre = gesamtscore_pre,
  post = gesamtscore_post
)

table(dat$class)
# 1415  31#7105     3677     5089     5896     5956     6085     6086     6208     6218     6228     6238     6248     6257     6268 
#    1        2       41        4        3        3        2        1       42      142       12       17       15       20       13 
# 6288 631#6288     6327     6367     6368     6388     6418     6438     6498     6508     6578     6588     6608     6617     6688 
#   25       19       32       22       10        6       13       28       31       11       11        7       37       56       18 
# 6777     7018     7087     7198     7227     7237 727#7548     7278     7307     7327     7348     7358     7387     7407     7418 
#   15       42       17       52       18       14       21       14       10       18       12        7       14        8       34 
# 7428     7437     7447     7457     7467     7608     7628     7637     7807 781#7828 783#7828     8027     8028     8087 809#8107 
#    7       11       37       16        7       40        2       15       41       20       18       16       19       11       16 
# 8428     8547     8608     8618     8658     8678     8798     8888     8978     8987 
#   19       24       13       20        8       11       16       28       19       21 

#Remove classes with only 1 to 4 students. Strictly speaking, this would not be necessary as multilevel
#modeling also works for classes of size 1. We do this so that the total number of students is comparable to 
#the published article (Edelsbrunner et al., 2024)
dat <- dat %>% mutate(cond = ifelse(cond == "Kontrollgruppe", "Control", "Intervention"))
dat <- dat %>% dplyr::filter(class != "1415")
dat <- dat %>% dplyr::filter(class != "31#7105")
dat <- dat %>% dplyr::filter(class != "5089")
dat <- dat %>% dplyr::filter(class != "5896")
dat <- dat %>% dplyr::filter(class != "5956")
dat <- dat %>% dplyr::filter(class != "6085")
dat <- dat %>% dplyr::filter(class != "6086")
dat <- dat %>% dplyr::filter(class != "7628")

#Dummy coding classes
for (i in 1:length(unique(dat$class))) {
  dat <- dat %>% mutate(class = ifelse(class == (unique(dat$class))[i], i, class))
}

#Convert sum scores to solution rates (max. 26 points in pretest/posttest)
dat <- dat %>% mutate(
  cond = as.factor(cond),
  class = as.numeric(class),
  pre = pre,
  post = post
)

#Filter conditions
control <- dat %>% filter(cond == "Control")
intervention <- dat %>% filter(cond == "Intervention")

n_1 <- nrow(control)#939
n_2 <- nrow(intervention)#438
n <- n_1 + n_2#1377

#Convert wide format of data to long format
dat_long <- dat %>% pivot_longer(
  cols = c("pre", "post"),
  names_to = "time",
  values_to = "score"
)

dat_long <- dat_long %>% mutate(time = fct_relevel(time, "pre", "post"))

#Violin Plot of Scores
ggplot(dat_long, aes(time, score, fill = cond)) +
  geom_violin(aes(fill = cond), trim = TRUE, alpha = 1/5, scale = "count") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(0.9), alpha = 1/5) + stat_summary(fun=mean, colour="black", geom="point", shape=5, size=3, show.legend=TRUE,position = position_dodge(0.9)) + stat_summary(aes(label=round(after_stat(y),2)), geom="text", size=6, vjust = 0.5, hjust = -0.6, position = position_dodge(0.9)) + scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Pretest", "Posttest")) + xlab("") + ylim(0, 26) + ylab("Sum Score (Max. = 26 Points)") + theme_classic(base_size = size - 2) + labs(fill = "Condition") + scale_fill_grey() + scale_color_grey() + labs(color='') 
```

#Modelling Aspects
##Bayesian Repeated-Measures ANOVA Model (no multilevel structure, no heterogeneous residual variances)
###Gaussian Distribution
```{r}
#Default Settings in brms:
# - Number of MCMC chains = 4
# - iter = 2000
# - warm-up = floor(iter/2) = 1000
# - thin = 1
# - seed = NA
# - adapt_delta = 0.95
# - max_treedepth = 10

#Default Prior Distributions
get_prior(bf(score ~ 0 + time * cond + (1|id)), 
  data = dat_long)
 #               prior class                      coef group resp dpar nlpar lb ub       source
 #               (flat)     b                                                            default
 #               (flat)     b          condIntervention                             (vectorized)
 #               (flat)     b                  timepost                             (vectorized)
 #               (flat)     b timepost:condIntervention                             (vectorized)
 #               (flat)     b                   timepre                             (vectorized)
 # student_t(3, 0, 2.5)    sd                                                  0         default
 # student_t(3, 0, 2.5)    sd                              id                  0    (vectorized)
 # student_t(3, 0, 2.5)    sd                 Intercept    id                  0    (vectorized)
 # student_t(3, 0, 2.5) sigma                                                  0         default

ANOVA_1 <- brm(
  bf(score ~ 0 + time * cond + (1|id)), 
  data = dat_long, 
  seed = 0
)

plot(ANOVA_1)
save(ANOVA_1, file = "ANOVA_1.RObject")

pp_check(ANOVA_1, ndraws = 100) + theme_classic(base_size = size) + ylab("Density") + xlab("Score") + scale_fill_grey() + scale_color_grey() + labs(color='') 

#Grouped pp-Checks
#Dense Overlay
pp_check(ANOVA_1, ndraws = 100, type = "dens_overlay_grouped", group = "cond")
pp_check(ANOVA_1, ndraws = 100, type = "dens_overlay_grouped", group = "time")

#Residual Error
pp_check(ANOVA_1, type = "error_scatter_avg_grouped", group = "cond")
pp_check(ANOVA_1, type = "error_scatter_avg_grouped", group = "time")

#PIT-ECDF
pp_check(ANOVA_1, ndraws = 100, type = "pit_ecdf_grouped", group = "cond")
pp_check(ANOVA_1, ndraws = 100, type = "pit_ecdf_grouped", group = "time")

summary(ANOVA_1, prob = 0.95)
#  Family: gaussian 
#   Links: mu = identity; sigma = identity 
# Formula: score ~ 0 + time * cond + (1 | id) 
#    Data: dat_long (Number of observations: 2754) 
#   Draws: 4 chains, each with iter = 2000; warmup = 1000; thin = 1;
#          total post-warmup draws = 4000
# 
# Multilevel Hyperparameters:
# ~id (Number of levels: 1377) 
#               Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
# sd(Intercept)     2.56      0.10     2.35     2.76 1.00      928     1821
# 
# Regression Coefficients:
#                           Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
# timepre                       9.63      0.14     9.36     9.90 1.00     2540     2871
# timepost                     15.63      0.14    15.36    15.91 1.00     2767     2668
# condIntervention              1.08      0.25     0.61     1.56 1.00     2501     2636
# timepost:condIntervention    -0.14      0.28    -0.69     0.41 1.00     3102     2837
# 
# Further Distributional Parameters:
#       Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
# sigma     3.46      0.06     3.33     3.59 1.00     1281     2082
# 
# Draws were sampled using sampling(NUTS). For each parameter, Bulk_ESS
# and Tail_ESS are effective sample size measures, and Rhat is the potential
# scale reduction factor on split chains (at convergence, Rhat = 1).
```

##Bayesian Repeated-Measures ANOVA Model (with multilevel structure, with heterogeneous residual variances)
```{r}
#Bayesian Intraclass Correlation Coefficient
icc <- brm(
  bf(post ~ (1|class)), 
  data = dat, 
  family = skew_normal(),
  seed = 0
)

pp_check(icc, ndraws = 100) + theme_classic(base_size = size) + ylab("Density") + xlab("Posttest Solution Rate")
performance::variance_decomposition(icc, ci = 0.95)
# # Random Effect Variances and ICC
# 
# Conditioned on: all random effects
# 
# ## Variance Ratio (comparable to ICC)
# Ratio: 0.17  CI 95%: [0.06 0.26]
# 
# ## Variances of Posterior Predicted Distribution
# Conditioned on fixed effects: 18.90  CI 95%: [16.83 21.14]
# Conditioned on rand. effects: 22.70  CI 95%: [20.43 25.26]
# 
# ## Difference in Variances
# Difference: 3.81  CI 95%: [1.34 6.34]

#General Model Check
check_model(lmer(score ~ 0 + time * cond + (1|id) + (0 + time * cond||class), data = dat_long))
check_normality(lmer(score ~ 0 + time * cond + (1|id) + (0 + time * cond||class), data = dat_long))

ANOVA_3 <- brm(
  bf(score ~ 0 + time * cond + (1|id) + (0 + time * cond|class), 
     sigma ~ 0 + time * cond + (0 + time * cond|class)), 
  data = dat_long, 
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(13, 7), class = "b"),
    prior(normal(1, 2), class = "b", dpar = "sigma")
  ),
  warmup = 2500,
  iter = 5000,
  cores = parallel::detectCores(),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 15),
  save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
  seed = 0
)

loo <- loo(ANOVA_3)
# Computed from 10000 by 2754 log-likelihood matrix.
# 
#          Estimate   SE
# elpd_loo  -7497.9 36.2
# p_loo       846.3 17.6
# looic     14995.8 72.3
# ------
# MCSE of elpd_loo is NA.
# MCSE and ESS estimates assume MCMC draws (r_eff in [0.3, 2.1]).
# 
# Pareto k diagnostic values:
#                          Count Pct.    Min. ESS
# (-Inf, 0.7]   (good)     2628  95.4%   258     
#    (0.7, 1]   (bad)       126   4.6%   <NA>    
#    (1, Inf)   (very bad)    0   0.0%   <NA>    
# See help('pareto-k-diagnostic') for details.
plot(ANOVA_3)
save(ANOVA_3, file = "ANOVA_3.RObject")
pp_check(ANOVA_3, ndraws = 100)

#Grouped pp-Checks
#Dense Overlay
pp_check(ANOVA_3, ndraws = 100, type = "dens_overlay_grouped", group = "cond")
pp_check(ANOVA_3, ndraws = 100, type = "dens_overlay_grouped", group = "time")
pp_check(ANOVA_3, ndraws = 100, type = "dens_overlay_grouped", group = "class")

#Residual Error
pp_check(ANOVA_3, type = "error_scatter_avg_grouped", group = "cond")
pp_check(ANOVA_3, type = "error_scatter_avg_grouped", group = "time")
pp_check(ANOVA_3, type = "error_scatter_avg_grouped", group = "class")

#ECDF
pp_check(ANOVA_3, ndraws = 100, type = "ecdf_overlay_grouped", group = "cond")
pp_check(ANOVA_3, ndraws = 100, type = "ecdf_overlay_grouped", group = "time")
pp_check(ANOVA_3, ndraws = 100, type = "ecdf_overlay_grouped", group = "class")

#PIT
pp_check(ANOVA_3, ndraws = 100, type = "pit_ecdf")
# Evaluating models with a standard Probability Integral Transform (PIT) or standard ECDF can
# suffer from the PIT pulling posterior draws too tightly toward the center (due to the "double
# use" of data). Using LOO-PIT ECDF (Leave-One-Out PIT Empirical Cumulative Distribution
# Function) solves this problem by assessing model calibration securely.
pp_check(ANOVA_3, ndraws = 100, type = "loo_pit_ecdf")
pp_check(ANOVA_3, ndraws = 100, type = "pit_ecdf_grouped", group = "class")

pp_check(ANOVA_3, type = "error_scatter_avg") + theme_classic(base_size = size)
summary(ANOVA_3, prob = 0.95)
#  Family: gaussian 
#   Links: mu = identity; sigma = log 
# Formula: score ~ 0 + time * cond + (1 | id) + (0 + time * cond | class) 
#          sigma ~ 0 + time * cond + (0 + time * cond | class)
#    Data: dat_long (Number of observations: 2754) 
#   Draws: 4 chains, each with iter = 5000; warmup = 2500; thin = 1;
#          total post-warmup draws = 10000
# 
# Multilevel Hyperparameters:
# ~class (Number of levels: 62) 
#                                                             Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
# sd(timepre)                                                     1.26      0.18     0.93     1.65 1.00     3247     5146
# sd(timepost)                                                    2.24      0.27     1.75     2.83 1.00     2788     4834
# sd(condIntervention)                                            0.58      0.35     0.03     1.32 1.00     1478     2800
# sd(timepost:condIntervention)                                   0.96      0.60     0.05     2.22 1.00     1315     3480
# sd(sigma_timepre)                                               0.09      0.05     0.01     0.21 1.00     1135     2720
# sd(sigma_timepost)                                              0.09      0.05     0.00     0.19 1.00     1659     2578
# sd(sigma_condIntervention)                                      0.10      0.07     0.00     0.24 1.00     2468     4718
# sd(sigma_timepost:condIntervention)                             0.10      0.08     0.00     0.29 1.00     2959     4198
# cor(timepre,timepost)                                           0.14      0.17    -0.21     0.45 1.00     1521     2709
# cor(timepre,condIntervention)                                  -0.02      0.39    -0.71     0.76 1.00     5477     6043
# cor(timepost,condIntervention)                                  0.05      0.38    -0.67     0.78 1.00     5975     6689
# cor(timepre,timepost:condIntervention)                         -0.03      0.37    -0.74     0.69 1.00     6672     5677

# cor(sigma_timepre,sigma_timepost)                               0.11      0.42    -0.73     0.83 1.00     3315     5375
# cor(sigma_timepre,sigma_condIntervention)                      -0.01      0.44    -0.80     0.79 1.00     5239     6292
# cor(sigma_timepost,sigma_condIntervention)                     -0.10      0.45    -0.86     0.76 1.00     4351     5996
# cor(sigma_timepre,sigma_timepost:condIntervention)              0.02      0.44    -0.80     0.82 1.00     8105     7241
# cor(sigma_timepost,sigma_timepost:condIntervention)            -0.17      0.45    -0.89     0.75 1.00     5633     6680
# cor(sigma_condIntervention,sigma_timepost:condIntervention)    -0.12      0.45    -0.86     0.76 1.00     7159     7152

# ~id (Number of levels: 1377) 
#               Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
# sd(Intercept)     2.46      0.09     2.28     2.65 1.00     2391     4877
# 
# Regression Coefficients:
#                                 Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
# timepre                             9.49      0.21     9.08     9.91 1.00     3719     5286
# timepost                           15.32      0.34    14.64    15.97 1.00     2518     4030
# condIntervention                    0.99      0.29     0.40     1.54 1.00     5456     6038
# timepost:condIntervention           0.07      0.39    -0.67     0.85 1.00     6434     5234
# sigma_timepre                       0.93      0.05     0.84     1.02 1.00     2474     4296
# sigma_timepost                      1.25      0.04     1.17     1.31 1.00     5150     4878
# sigma_condIntervention              0.03      0.08    -0.12     0.17 1.00     4133     5259
# sigma_timepost:condIntervention    -0.03      0.10    -0.22     0.17 1.00     4412     5846
# 
# Draws were sampled using sampling(NUTS). For each parameter, Bulk_ESS
# and Tail_ESS are effective sample size measures, and Rhat is the potential
# scale reduction factor on split chains (at convergence, Rhat = 1).
# summary(ANOVA_3, prob = 0.90)

#Prior Sensitivity Check via LOO
ANOVA_3_student <- brm(
  bf(score ~ 0 + time * cond + (1|id) + (0 + time * cond|class), 
     sigma ~ 0 + time * cond + (0 + time * cond|class)), 
  data = dat_long, 
  family = student(),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(13, 7), class = "b"),
    prior(normal(1, 2), class = "b", dpar = "sigma")
  ),
  warmup = 2500,
  iter = 5000,
  cores = parallel::detectCores(),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 15),
  save_pars = save_pars(all = TRUE),
  seed = 0
)

save(ANOVA_3_student, file = "ANOVA_3_student.RObject")
loo_student <- loo(ANOVA_3_student)
# Computed from 10000 by 2754 log-likelihood matrix.
# 
#          Estimate   SE
# elpd_loo  -7505.5 36.5
# p_loo       868.8 17.3
# looic     15011.0 72.9
# ------
# MCSE of elpd_loo is NA.
# MCSE and ESS estimates assume MCMC draws (r_eff in [0.3, 2.0]).
# 
# Pareto k diagnostic values:
#                          Count Pct.    Min. ESS
# (-Inf, 0.7]   (good)     2689  97.6%   274     
#    (0.7, 1]   (bad)        65   2.4%   <NA>    
#    (1, Inf)   (very bad)    0   0.0%   <NA>    
# See help('pareto-k-diagnostic') for details.
loo_compare(loo, loo_student)
#                 elpd_diff se_diff
# ANOVA_3          0.0       0.0   
# ANOVA_3_student -7.6       1.8   
```

#Between-Group Design
##Pretest
```{r}
cohens_d(intervention$pre, control$pre, pooled_sd = FALSE, paired = FALSE, ci = 0.95)
# Cohen's d |       95% CI
# ------------------------
# 0.28      | [0.17, 0.40]

cohens_d_cl_pr <- data.frame(cl = 1:62, d_s = numeric(62))

for (l in 1:62) {
  intervention_cl <- intervention %>% filter(class == l)
  control_cl <- control %>% filter(class == l)
  cohens_d_cl_pr$d_s[l] <- as.numeric(cohens_d(intervention_cl$pre, control_cl$pre, pooled_sd = FALSE, paired = FALSE, ci = 0.95))[1]
}  

mean(cohens_d_cl_pr$d_s, na.rm = TRUE)
```

###Gaussian Distribution
####Flat Priors
```{r}
ttest_pr_gaussian_flat <- brm(bf(
  pre ~ cond + (0 + cond|class),
  sigma ~ 0 + cond + (0 + cond|class)),
  family = gaussian(),
  data = dat,
  warmup = 2500,
  iter = 5000,
  cores = parallel::detectCores(),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 15),
  seed = 0
)

plot(ttest_pr_gaussian_flat)

#Grouped pp-Checks
#Dense Overlay
pp_check(ttest_pr_gaussian_flat, ndraws = 100, type = "dens_overlay_grouped", group = "cond")
pp_check(ttest_pr_gaussian_flat, ndraws = 100, type = "dens_overlay_grouped", group = "class")

#Residual Error
pp_check(ttest_pr_gaussian_flat, type = "error_scatter_avg_grouped", group = "cond")
pp_check(ttest_pr_gaussian_flat, type = "error_scatter_avg_grouped", group = "class")

#PIT-ECDF
pp_check(ttest_pr_gaussian_flat, ndraws = 100, type = "pit_ecdf_grouped", group = "cond")
pp_check(ttest_pr_gaussian_flat, ndraws = 100, type = "pit_ecdf_grouped", group = "class")

summary(ttest_pr_gaussian_flat, prob = 0.95)
#  Family: gaussian 
#   Links: mu = identity; sigma = log 
# Formula: pre ~ cond + (0 + cond | class) 
#          sigma ~ 0 + cond + (0 + cond | class)
#    Data: dat (Number of observations: 1377) 
#   Draws: 4 chains, each with iter = 5000; warmup = 2500; thin = 1;
#          total post-warmup draws = 10000
# 
# Multilevel Hyperparameters:
# ~class (Number of levels: 62) 
#                                               Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
# sd(condControl)                                   1.28      0.19     0.93     1.70 1.00     3907     6020
# sd(condIntervention)                              1.30      0.29     0.78     1.90 1.00     4838     6301
# sd(sigma_condControl)                             0.06      0.03     0.00     0.13 1.00     3472     4550
# sd(sigma_condIntervention)                        0.09      0.06     0.01     0.22 1.00     2664     4027
# cor(condControl,condIntervention)                 0.69      0.21     0.18     0.97 1.00     2810     3900
# cor(sigma_condControl,sigma_condIntervention)     0.18      0.55    -0.91     0.96 1.00     3852     5360
# 
# Regression Coefficients:
#                        Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
# Intercept                  9.50      0.22     9.07     9.91 1.00     3907     5917
# condIntervention           0.92      0.31     0.29     1.53 1.00     6191     7383
# sigma_condControl          1.26      0.03     1.20     1.31 1.00    10094     6796
# sigma_condIntervention     1.30      0.04     1.21     1.38 1.00     8290     7275
# 
# Draws were sampled using sampling(NUTS). For each parameter, Bulk_ESS
# and Tail_ESS are effective sample size measures, and Rhat is the potential
# scale reduction factor on split chains (at convergence, Rhat = 1).
chains_ttest_pr <- get_chains(ttest_pr_gaussian_flat)

for (l in 1:length(unique(dat$class))) {
  name <- paste0("d_s_", l, "")
  name_control <- paste0("r_class.", l, ".condControl.")
  name_intervention <- paste0("r_class.", l, ".condIntervention.")
  name_sigma_control <- paste0("r_class__sigma.", l, ".condControl.")
  name_sigma_intervention <- paste0("r_class__sigma.", l, ".condIntervention.")
  
  chains_ttest_pr[[name]] <- sqrt(n - 2) * (chains_ttest_pr$b_condIntervention + chains_ttest_pr[names(chains_ttest_pr) == name_intervention] - chains_ttest_pr[names(chains_ttest_pr) == name_control])/sqrt((n_1 - 1) * (exp(2 * chains_ttest_pr$b_sigma_condControl + 2 * chains_ttest_pr[names(chains_ttest_pr) == name_sigma_control] + 2 * chains_ttest_pr$sd_class__sigma_condControl^2) + chains_ttest_pr$sd_class__condControl^2) + (n_2 - 1) * (exp(2 * chains_ttest_pr$b_sigma_condIntervention + 2 * chains_ttest_pr[names(chains_ttest_pr) == name_sigma_intervention] + 2 * chains_ttest_pr$sd_class__sigma_condIntervention^2) + chains_ttest_pr$sd_class__condIntervention^2))
}

chains_ttest_pr$d_s_mean <- rowMeans(subset(chains_ttest_pr, select = c(d_s_1:d_s_62)), na.rm = TRUE)
d_s_pr <- round(mean(chains_ttest_pr$d_s_mean), 2) #0.24
bayestestR::hdi(chains_ttest_pr$d_s_mean, ci = 0.95) #95% HDI: [0.09, 0.38]
chains_ttest_pr$d_s_sd <- apply(subset(chains_ttest_pr, select = c(d_s_1:d_s_62)), 1, sd)
d_s_sd_pr <- round(mean(chains_ttest_pr$d_s_sd), 2) #0.25
bayestestR::hdi(chains_ttest_pr$d_s_sd, ci = 0.95) #95% HDI: [0.10, 0.42]
```

```{r}
#  Family: zero_one_inflated_beta 
#   Links: mu = logit; phi = log; zoi = identity; coi = identity 
# Formula: sr_pre ~ 0 + cond 
#          phi ~ 0 + cond
#    Data: dat (Number of observations: 1377) 
#   Draws: 4 chains, each with iter = 5000; warmup = 2500; thin = 1;
#          total post-warmup draws = 10000
# 
# Regression Coefficients:
#                      Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
# condControl             -0.53      0.02    -0.57    -0.49 1.00    10677     7356
# condIntervention        -0.35      0.03    -0.41    -0.29 1.00     9018     7207
# phi_condControl          2.31      0.04     2.22     2.39 1.00    11667     8142
# phi_condIntervention     2.28      0.07     2.15     2.40 1.00     9926     7881
# 
# Further Distributional Parameters:
#     Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
# zoi     0.00      0.00     0.00     0.00 1.00     9734     5799
# coi     0.50      0.29     0.03     0.98 1.00    10860     5826
# 
# Draws were sampled using sampling(NUTS). For each parameter, Bulk_ESS
# and Tail_ESS are effective sample size measures, and Rhat is the potential
# scale reduction factor on split chains (at convergence, Rhat = 1).
chains_ttest_pr <- get_chains(ttest_pr_ZOIB_flat)

mu_0 <- sapply(chains_ttest_pr$b_condControl, invlogit)

chains_ttest_pr$d_s <- sqrt(n - 2) * (mu_1 - mu_0)/sqrt((n_1 - 1) * sigma_0^2 + (n_2 - 1) * sigma_1^2)

round(mean(chains_ttest_pr$d_s), 2) #0.29
bayestestR::hdi(chains_ttest_pr$d_s, ci = 0.95) #95% HDI: [0.17, 0.40]
```

###Simulation Study
####Monte-Carlo Run
```{r}
library(doFuture)
library(doRNG)
library(progressr)

#Global Simulation Settings
set.seed(0)
registerDoFuture()
plan(multisession, workers = 6)
handlers(global = TRUE)
handlers("cli")            # Alternatively use "progress" or "txtprogressbar" if desired
n_rep <- 480
all_results <- list()

beta_0 <- 9.50        # Control condition mean
beta_1 <- 1.00        # Treatment difference mean
  
gamma_0 <- 1.26      # Control condition log-sigma baseline sd
gamma_1 <- 1.30    # Treatment condition log-sigma baseline sd
        
sd_0 <- 1.30          # Control condition random location standard deviation
sd_1 <- 1.30          # Treatment condition random location standard deviation
rho_u <- 0.70         # Correlation random location slopes 
  
sd_sigma_0 <- 0.05    # Control condition random scale standard deviation
sd_sigma_1 <- 0.10  # Treatment condition random scale standard deviation
rho_v <- 0.20         # Correlation random scale slopes 

J_classes <- 62
p_val <- (438 - 1)/(1377 - 2)

loop <- function(r){
  # Generate correlated cluster-level location deviations (u_0j, u_1j)
  Sigma_u <- matrix(
    c(sd_0^2, rho_u * sd_0 * sd_1,
      rho_u * sd_0 * sd_1, sd_1^2
      ), nrow = 2)
  
  u_deviations <- MASS::mvrnorm(J_classes, mu = c(0, 0), Sigma = Sigma_u)
  
  # Generate correlated cluster-level scale deviations (v_0j, v_1j)
  Sigma_v <- matrix(
    c(sd_sigma_0^2, rho_v * sd_sigma_0 * sd_sigma_1,
      rho_v * sd_sigma_0 * sd_sigma_1, sd_sigma_1^2
    ), nrow = 2)
  
  v_deviations <- MASS::mvrnorm(J_classes, mu = c(0, 0), Sigma = Sigma_v)

  clust <- tibble(
    clus = 1:J_classes,
    u_0j = u_deviations[, 1],
    u_1j = u_deviations[, 2],
    v_0j = v_deviations[, 1],
    v_1j = v_deviations[, 2]
  )
    
  clust$n_j <- rpois(J_classes, lambda = 22) %>% pmax(10)

  # Expand to individual observations (within-cluster randomization)
  df <- clust %>%
    uncount(n_j) %>%
    group_by(clus) %>%
    mutate(
    cond = rbinom(length(clus), size = 1, prob = 438/1377),

    # Compute individual parameters using cell-means structure
    mu_ij = if_else(cond == 0, beta_0 + u_0j, beta_0 + beta_1 + u_1j),
    log_sigma_ij = if_else(cond == 0, gamma_0 + v_0j, gamma_1 + v_1j),
    sigma_ij = exp(log_sigma_ij),
    y = rnorm(length(clus), mean = mu_ij, sd = sigma_ij)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
    
  df <- df %>% dplyr::select(clus, cond, y)
  
  # Calculate true population hybrid SMD 
  var_total_0_cl <- sd_0^2 + exp(2 * gamma_0 + 2 * sd_sigma_0^2)
  var_total_1_cl <- sd_1^2 + exp(2 * gamma_1 + 2 * sd_sigma_1^2)
  sigma_global_sq_cl <- (1 - p_val) * var_total_0_cl + p_val * var_total_1_cl
  true_smd_cl <- beta_1 / sqrt(sigma_global_sq_cl)
  true_smd <- beta_1/sqrt((1 - p_val) * exp(2 * gamma_0) + p_val * exp(2 * gamma_1))
  
  df <- df %>% mutate(
    y = ifelse(y > 26, 26, ifelse(y < 0, 0, y)),
    cond = as.factor(cond)
  )
  
  # nrow(df %>% filter(cond == 0)) #939
  # nrow(df %>% filter(cond == 1)) #438
  # 
  # df %>% ggplot(aes(x = cond, y = y)) + geom_violin() + geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, alpha = 1/5) + stat_summary(fun = mean, colour = "black", geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 6, show.legend = FALSE) + theme_classic(base_size = font) + ylim(0, 26)
  
  # Fit full model
  fit_full <- brm(bf(
      y ~ cond + (0 + cond|clus),
      sigma ~ 0 + cond + (0 + cond|clus), decomp = "QR"),
    family = gaussian(),
    data = df ,
    warmup = 2000,
    iter = 4000,
    chains = 3,
    cores = parallel::detectCores (),
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99 , max_treedepth = 15),
    backend = "cmdstanr",
    stan_model_args = list(stanc_options = list("O1")),
    seed = 0,
    normalize = FALSE,
    refresh = 0,
    silent = 2
  )

  # pp_check(fit_full, type = "dens_overlay", ndraws = 100)
  # pp_check(fit_full, type = "dens_overlay_grouped", ndraws = 100, group = "cond")
  # pp_check(fit_full, type = "dens_overlay_grouped", ndraws = 100, group = "clus")
  #
  # pp_check(fit_full, type = "pit_ecdf", ndraws = 100)
  # pp_check(fit_full, type = "pit_ecdf_grouped", ndraws = 100, group = "cond")
  # pp_check(fit_full, type = "pit_ecdf_grouped", ndraws = 100, group = "clus")
  #
  # pp_check(fit_full, type = "error_scatter_avg")
  # pp_check(fit_full, type = "error_scatter_avg_grouped", group = "cond")
  # pp_check(fit_full, type = "error_scatter_avg_grouped", group = "clus")
  #
  # pp_check(fit_full, type = "loo_pit_ecdf", ndraws = 100)

  prediction_grid <- expand_grid(
    clus = unique(df$clus),
    cond = unique(df$cond)
  )

  draws <- as_draws_df(fit_full)

  cluster_ids <- unique(df$clus) # Extract all unique cluster names

  clusterwise_smd <- lapply(cluster_ids, function(j) {

    name_u_0 <- paste0("r_clus[", j, ",cond0]")
    name_u_1 <- paste0("r_clus[", j, ",cond1]")

    name_v_0  <- paste0("r_clus__sigma[", j, ",cond0]")
    name_v_1 <- paste0("r_clus__sigma[", j, ",cond1]")

    draws %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .draw,
        # Fixed effects
        beta_0 = b_Intercept,
        beta_1 = b_cond1,
        gamma_0 = b_sigma_cond0,
        gamma_1 = b_sigma_cond1,
        # Global random standard deviations
        sd_0    = sd_clus__cond0,
        sd_1    = sd_clus__cond1,
        sd_sigma_0  = sd_clus__sigma_cond0,
        sd_sigma_1  = sd_clus__sigma_cond1,
        # Cluster-specific random effects
        u_0      = all_of(name_u_0),
        u_1     = all_of(name_u_1),
        v_0     = all_of(name_v_0),
        v_1    = all_of(name_v_1)
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        clus = j, # Track cluster

        V_0 = sd_0^2 + exp(2 * gamma_0 + 2 * sd_sigma_0^2 + 2 * v_0),
        V_1 = sd_1^2 + exp(2 * gamma_1 + 2 * sd_sigma_1^2 + 2 * v_1),
        var_glob = (1 - p_val) * V_0 + p_val * V_1,
        hybrid_smd = (beta_1 + u_1 - u_0) / sqrt(var_glob)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(clus, .draw, hybrid_smd)
      }) %>%
        bind_rows()

  mean_smd_per_draw <- clusterwise_smd %>%
    group_by(.draw) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(
      mean_hybrid_smd = mean(hybrid_smd),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  summary_full <- mean_smd_per_draw %>%
    mean_hdci(mean_hybrid_smd) %>%
    mutate(model = "full", true_val = true_smd_cl)

  # Fit possibly misspecified reduced model
  fit_red <- brm(bf(
      y ~ cond,
      sigma ~ 0 + cond, decomp = "QR"),
    family = gaussian(),
    data = df,
    warmup = 2000,
    iter = 4000,
    chains = 3,
    cores = parallel::detectCores (),
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99 , max_treedepth = 15),
    backend = "cmdstanr",
    stan_model_args = list(stanc_options = list("O1")),
    seed = 0,
    normalize = FALSE,
    silent = 2,
    refresh = 0
  )

  # pp_check(fit_red, type = "dens_overlay", ndraws = 100)
  # pp_check(fit_red, type = "dens_overlay_grouped", ndraws = 100, group = "cond")
  #
  # pp_check(fit_red, type = "pit_ecdf", ndraws = 100)
  # pp_check(fit_red, type = "pit_ecdf_grouped", ndraws = 100, group = "cond")
  #
  # pp_check(fit_red, type = "error_scatter_avg")
  # pp_check(fit_red, type = "error_scatter_avg_grouped", group = "cond")
  #
  # pp_check(fit_red, type = "loo_pit_ecdf", ndraws = 100)

  prediction_grid <- expand_grid(
    cond = unique(df$cond)
  )

  draws <- as_draws_df(fit_red)

  draws <- draws %>%
    dplyr::select(
    .draw,
    # Fixed effects
    beta_0 = b_Intercept,
    beta_1 = b_cond1,
    gamma_0 = b_sigma_cond0,
    gamma_1 = b_sigma_cond1
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      V_0 = exp(2 * gamma_0),
      V_1 = exp(2 * gamma_1),
      V = (1 - p_val) * V_0 + p_val * V_1,
      mean_hybrid_smd = beta_1 / sqrt(V)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(.draw, mean_hybrid_smd) %>% bind_rows()

  summary_red <- draws %>%
    mean_hdci(mean_hybrid_smd) %>%
    mutate(model = "reduced", true_val = true_smd)
  
  df <- df %>% mutate(
    y = y/26
  )
  
  # Fit ZOIB model
  fit_ZOIB <- brm(bf(
      y ~ 0 + cond,
      phi ~ 0 + cond, decomp = "QR"),
    family = zero_one_inflated_beta(),
    data = df,
    warmup = 2000, 
    iter = 4000, 
    chains = 3,
    cores = parallel::detectCores (),
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99 , max_treedepth = 15),
    backend = "cmdstanr",
    stan_model_args = list(stanc_options = list("O1")),
    seed = 0,
    normalize = FALSE,
    silent = 2,
    refresh = 0
  )

  # pp_check(fit_ZOIB, type = "dens_overlay", ndraws = 100)
  # pp_check(fit_ZOIB, type = "dens_overlay_grouped", ndraws = 100, group = "cond")
  # 
  # pp_check(fit_ZOIB, type = "pit_ecdf", ndraws = 100)
  # pp_check(fit_ZOIB, type = "pit_ecdf_grouped", ndraws = 100, group = "cond")
  # 
  # pp_check(fit_ZOIB, type = "error_scatter_avg")
  # pp_check(fit_ZOIB, type = "error_scatter_avg_grouped", group = "cond")
  # 
  # pp_check(fit_ZOIB, type = "loo_pit_ecdf", ndraws = 100)
  
  prediction_grid <- expand_grid(
    cond = unique(df$cond)
  )

  draws <- as_draws_df(fit_ZOIB)
  
  draws <- draws %>%
    dplyr::select(
    .draw,
    # Fixed effects
    beta_0 = b_cond0,
    beta_1 = b_cond1,
    phi_0 = b_phi_cond0,
    phi_1 = b_phi_cond1
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      mu_0 = invlogit(beta_0),
      mu_1 = invlogit(beta_1),
      V_0 = sigma_ZOIB(mu_0, phi_0)^2,
      V_1 = sigma_ZOIB(mu_1, phi_1)^2,
      V = (1 - p_val) * V_0 + p_val * V_1,
      mean_hybrid_smd = (invlogit(beta_1) - invlogit(beta_0)) / sqrt(V)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(.draw, mean_hybrid_smd) %>% bind_rows()
    
  summary_ZOIB <- draws %>%
    mean_hdci(mean_hybrid_smd) %>%
    mutate(model = "ZOIB", true_val = true_smd)
  
  p(message = sprintf("Rep %d", r))
     
  #Summarise results
  bind_rows(summary_full, summary_red, summary_ZOIB) %>%
    dplyr::select(model, estimate = mean_hybrid_smd, conf.low = .lower, conf.high = .upper, true_val)
}

with_progress({
  p <- progressor(steps = n_rep)
  suppressWarnings(estimates_d_s <- foreach(r = 1:n_rep, .combine = 'rbind', .packages = "progressr") %dorng% loop(r))
})

save(estimates_d_s, file = "estimates_d_s.RObject")
```

```{r}
# Cohen's d |       95% CI

# 0.20      | [0.08, 0.31]

cohens_d_cl_po <- data.frame(cl = 1:62, d_s = numeric(62))

for (l in 1:62) {
  intervention_cl <- intervention %>% filter(class == l)
  control_cl <- control %>% filter(class == l)
```

###Gaussian Distribution
####Flat Priors
```{r}
ttest_po_gaussian_flat <- brm(bf(
  post ~ cond + (0 + cond|class),
  sigma ~ 0 + cond + (0 + cond|class)),
  family = gaussian(),
  data = dat,
  warmup = 2500,
  iter = 5000,
  cores = parallel::detectCores(),
  control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 15),
  seed = 0
)

plot(ttest_po_gaussian_flat)

#Grouped pp-Checks
#Dense Overlay
pp_check(ttest_po_gaussian_flat, ndraws = 100, type = "dens_overlay_grouped", group = "cond")
pp_check(ttest_po_gaussian_flat, ndraws = 100, type = "dens_overlay_grouped", group = "class")

#Residual Error
pp_check(ttest_po_gaussian_flat, type = "error_scatter_avg_grouped", group = "cond")
pp_check(ttest_po_gaussian_flat, type = "error_scatter_avg_grouped", group = "class")

#PIT-ECDF
pp_check(ttest_po_gaussian_flat, ndraws = 100, type = "pit_ecdf_grouped", group = "cond")
pp_check(ttest_po_gaussian_flat, ndraws = 100, type = "pit_ecdf_grouped", group = "class")

summary(ttest_po_gaussian_flat, prob = 0.95)
#  Family: gaussian 
#   Links: mu = identity; sigma = log 
# Formula: post ~ cond + (0 + cond | class) 
#          sigma ~ 0 + cond + (0 + cond | class)
#    Data: dat (Number of observations: 1377) 
#   Draws: 4 chains, each with iter = 5000; warmup = 2500; thin = 1;
#          total post-warmup draws = 10000
# 
# Multilevel Hyperparameters:
# ~class (Number of levels: 62) 
#                                               Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
# sd(condControl)                                   2.33      0.29     1.80     2.95 1.00     2855     5213
# sd(condIntervention)                              2.00      0.37     1.35     2.79 1.00     4718     6717
# sd(sigma_condControl)                             0.09      0.04     0.01     0.17 1.00     2509     2846
# sd(sigma_condIntervention)                        0.08      0.06     0.00     0.22 1.00     2832     4613
# cor(condControl,condIntervention)                 0.68      0.19     0.21     0.96 1.00     2398     3693
# cor(sigma_condControl,sigma_condIntervention)    -0.13      0.57    -0.96     0.92 1.00     4507     5100
# 
# Regression Coefficients:
#                        Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
# Intercept                 15.32      0.35    14.62    15.99 1.00     2430     4127
# condIntervention           1.10      0.43     0.26     1.96 1.00     5108     5711
# sigma_condControl          1.44      0.03     1.38     1.49 1.00     6773     7752
# sigma_condIntervention     1.47      0.04     1.38     1.55 1.00     8296     6502
# 
# Draws were sampled using sampling(NUTS). For each parameter, Bulk_ESS
# and Tail_ESS are effective sample size measures, and Rhat is the potential
# scale reduction factor on split chains (at convergence, Rhat = 1).
chains_ttest_po <- get_chains(ttest_po_gaussian_flat)

for (l in 1:length(unique(dat$class))) {
  name <- paste0("d_s_", l, "")
  name_control <- paste0("r_class.", l, ".condControl.")
  name_intervention <- paste0("r_class.", l, ".condIntervention.")
  name_sigma_control <- paste0("r_class__sigma.", l, ".condControl.")
  name_sigma_intervention <- paste0("r_class__sigma.", l, ".condIntervention.")
  
  chains_ttest_po[[name]] <- sqrt(n - 2) * (chains_ttest_po$b_condIntervention + chains_ttest_po[names(chains_ttest_po) == name_intervention] - chains_ttest_po[names(chains_ttest_po) == name_control])/sqrt((n_1 - 1) * (exp(2 * chains_ttest_po$b_sigma_condControl + 2 * chains_ttest_po[names(chains_ttest_po) == name_sigma_control] + 2 * chains_ttest_po$sd_class__sigma_condControl^2) + chains_ttest_po$sd_class__condControl^2) + (n_2 - 1) * (exp(2 * chains_ttest_po$b_sigma_condIntervention + 2 * chains_ttest_po[names(chains_ttest_po) == name_sigma_intervention] + 2 * chains_ttest_po$sd_class__sigma_condIntervention^2) + chains_ttest_po$sd_class__condIntervention^2))
}

chains_ttest_po$d_s_mean <- rowMeans(subset(chains_ttest_po, select = c(d_s_1:d_s_62)), na.rm = TRUE)
d_s_po <- round(mean(chains_ttest_po$d_s_mean), 2) #0.23
bayestestR::hdi(chains_ttest_po$d_s_mean, ci = 0.95) #95% HDI: [0.08, 0.38]
chains_ttest_po$d_s_sd <- apply(subset(chains_ttest_po, select = c(d_s_1:d_s_62)), 1, sd)
d_s_sd_po <- round(mean(chains_ttest_po$d_s_sd), 2) #0.34
bayestestR::hdi(chains_ttest_po$d_s_sd, ci = 0.95) #95% HDI: [0.15, 0.54]

#Histogram
random <- data.frame(
  cl = rep(1:62, 2),
  d_s = c(
    colMeans(subset(chains_ttest_pr, select = c(d_s_1:d_s_62)), na.rm = TRUE),
    colMeans(subset(chains_ttest_po, select = c(d_s_1:d_s_62)), na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  Time = c(rep("Pretest", 62), rep("Posttest", 62)),
  mean = c(rep(d_s_pr, 62), rep(d_s_po, 62)),
  low = c(rep(d_s_pr - d_s_sd_pr, 62), rep(d_s_po - d_s_sd_po, 62)),
  high = c(rep(d_s_pr + d_s_sd_pr, 62), rep(d_s_po + d_s_sd_po, 62))
)

random <- random %>% mutate(Time = as.factor(Time))
random <- random %>% mutate(Time = fct_relevel(Time, "Pretest", "Posttest"))
  
random %>% ggplot(aes(x = d_s)) + geom_histogram(bins = 70, color = "black", alpha = 0.3, linewidth = .1) + ylab("Frequency") + theme_classic(base_size = size) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty(random$d_s, n = 6)) + xlab(TeX("Cohen's $d_s$ for each Class via Partial Pooling")) + geom_vline(aes(xintercept = mean), linetype="dashed", linewidth = 1) + geom_segment(data = random, aes(x = low, xend = high, y = 0, yend = 0), inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "black", linewidth = 2.5)+ facet_wrap(~Time) + scale_fill_grey() + scale_color_grey() + labs(color='') 

#Learning per class
random %>% ggplot(aes(x = Time, y = d_s, group = cl)) + geom_point(alpha = 0.3) + geom_path(alpha = 0.3) + scale_fill_grey() + scale_color_grey() + labs(color='') + xlab("Time") + ylab(TeX("Cohen's $d_s$ ")) + scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty(random$d_s, n = 5)) + theme_classic(base_size = size)
```

```{r}
summary(ttest_po_skew_normal, prob = 0.95)
#  Family: skew_normal 
#   Links: mu = identity; sigma = log 
# Formula: post ~ cond + (0 + cond | class) 
#          sigma ~ 0 + cond + (0 + cond | class)
#    Data: dat (Number of observations: 1377) 
#   Draws: 4 chains, each with iter = 5000; warmup = 2500; thin = 1;
#          total post-warmup draws = 10000
# 
# Multilevel Hyperparameters:
# ~class (Number of levels: 62) 
#                                               Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
# sd(condControl)                                   2.28      0.29     1.76     2.91 1.00     2910     5072
# sd(condIntervention)                              1.92      0.37     1.30     2.72 1.00     3793     6102
# sd(sigma_condControl)                             0.10      0.04     0.01     0.18 1.00     2192     1493
# sd(sigma_condIntervention)                        0.08      0.06     0.00     0.21 1.00     2839     4751
# cor(condControl,condIntervention)                 0.65      0.21     0.15     0.96 1.00     1903     3455
# cor(sigma_condControl,sigma_condIntervention)    -0.12      0.57    -0.96     0.93 1.00     4468     5750
# 
# Regression Coefficients:
#                        Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
# Intercept                 15.32      0.34    14.63    15.98 1.00     2285     3412
# condIntervention           1.14      0.43     0.31     2.01 1.00     4450     6163
# sigma_condControl          1.45      0.03     1.39     1.51 1.00     7508     7307
# sigma_condIntervention     1.46      0.04     1.37     1.54 1.00     7234     6469
# 
# Further Distributional Parameters:
#       Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
# alpha    -1.74      0.29    -2.33    -1.20 1.00    10422     7387
# 
# Draws were sampled using sampling(NUTS). For each parameter, Bulk_ESS
# and Tail_ESS are effective sample size measures, and Rhat is the potential
# scale reduction factor on split chains (at convergence, Rhat = 1).
chains_ttest_po <- get_chains(ttest_po_skew_normal)

for (l in 1:length(unique(dat$class))) {
  name <- paste0("d_s_", l, "")
  name_control <- paste0("r_class.", l, ".condControl.")
  name_intervention <- paste0("r_class.", l, ".condIntervention.")
  name_sigma_control <- paste0("r_class__sigma.", l, ".condControl.")
  name_sigma_intervention <- paste0("r_class__sigma.", l, ".condIntervention.")
  
  chains_ttest_po[[name]] <- sqrt(n - 2) * (chains_ttest_po$b_condIntervention + chains_ttest_po[names(chains_ttest_po) == name_intervention] - chains_ttest_po[names(chains_ttest_po) == name_control])/sqrt((n_1 - 1) * (exp(2 * chains_ttest_po$b_sigma_condControl + 2 * chains_ttest_po[names(chains_ttest_po) == name_sigma_control] + 2 * chains_ttest_po$sd_class__sigma_condControl^2) + chains_ttest_po$sd_class__condControl^2) + (n_2 - 1) * (exp(2 * chains_ttest_po$b_sigma_condIntervention + 2 * chains_ttest_po[names(chains_ttest_po) == name_sigma_intervention] + 2 * chains_ttest_po$sd_class__sigma_condIntervention^2) + chains_ttest_po$sd_class__condIntervention^2))
}

chains_ttest_po$d_s_mean <- rowMeans(subset(chains_ttest_po, select = c(d_s_1:d_s_62)), na.rm = TRUE)

bayestestR::hdi(chains_ttest_po$d_s_mean, ci = 0.95) #95% HDI: [0.09, 0.38]
```

###Zero-One-Inflated Beta
####Flat Priors
```{r}
 ttest_po_ZOIB_flat <- brm(bf(
      sr_post ~ 0 + cond,
      phi ~ 0 + cond),
      family = zero_one_inflated_beta(),
    data = dat,
    warmup = 2500,
    iter = 5000,
    cores = parallel::detectCores(),
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.95, max_treedepth = 15),
    seed = 0
  )
        
plot(ttest_po_ZOIB_flat)

#Grouped pp-Checks
#Dense Overlay
pp_check(ttest_po_ZOIB_flat, ndraws = 100, type = "dens_overlay_grouped", group = "cond")

#Residual Error
pp_check(ttest_po_ZOIB_flat, type = "error_scatter_avg_grouped", group = "cond")

#PIT-ECDF
pp_check(ttest_po_ZOIB_flat, ndraws = 100, type = "pit_ecdf_grouped", group = "cond")

summary(ttest_po_ZOIB_flat, prob = 0.95)
#  Family: zero_one_inflated_beta 
#   Links: mu = logit; phi = log; zoi = identity; coi = identity 
# Formula: sr_post ~ 0 + cond 
#          phi ~ 0 + cond
#    Data: dat (Number of observations: 1377) 
#   Draws: 4 chains, each with iter = 5000; warmup = 2500; thin = 1;
#          total post-warmup draws = 10000
# 
# Regression Coefficients:
#                      Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
# condControl              0.40      0.02     0.35     0.44 1.00    12178     7722
# condIntervention         0.54      0.04     0.47     0.61 1.00    12415     7552
# phi_condControl          1.86      0.04     1.77     1.94 1.00    13349     7305
# phi_condIntervention     1.81      0.06     1.68     1.93 1.00    11625     7726
# 
# Further Distributional Parameters:
#     Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
# zoi     0.01      0.00     0.00     0.01 1.00    12383     6961
# coi     0.92      0.08     0.72     1.00 1.00    10930     5094
# 
# Draws were sampled using sampling(NUTS). For each parameter, Bulk_ESS
# and Tail_ESS are effective sample size measures, and Rhat is the potential
# scale reduction factor on split chains (at convergence, Rhat = 1).
chains_ttest_po <- get_chains(ttest_po_ZOIB_flat)

mu_0 <- sapply(chains_ttest_po$b_condControl, invlogit)
mu_1 <- sapply(chains_ttest_po$b_condIntervention, invlogit)
  
sigma_0 <- mapply(sigma_ZOIB, mu_0, unlist(chains_ttest_po$b_phi_condControl))
sigma_1 <-  mapply(sigma_ZOIB, mu_1, unlist(chains_ttest_po$b_phi_condIntervention))
  
chains_ttest_po$d_s <- sqrt(n - 2) * (mu_1 - mu_0)/sqrt((n_1 - 1) * sigma_0^2 + (n_2 - 1) * sigma_1^2)

round(mean(chains_ttest_po$d_s), 2) #0.19
bayestestR::hdi(chains_ttest_po$d_s, ci = 0.95) #95% HDI: [0.08, 0.31]
```

```{r}
# sd(condIntervention)                              2.00      0.37     1.35     2.81 1.00     5235     7272
# sd(sigma_condControl)                             0.08      0.04     0.00     0.16 1.00     2452     3364
# sd(sigma_condIntervention)                        0.07      0.05     0.00     0.18 1.00     3557     4201
# cor(condControl,condIntervention)                 0.72      0.20     0.25     0.98 1.00     2206     3596
# cor(sigma_condControl,sigma_condIntervention)    -0.11      0.56    -0.96     0.93 1.00     5706     6083
# 
# Regression Coefficients:
#                        Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
# condControl                5.84      0.36     5.14     6.54 1.00     2260     3828
# condIntervention           6.02      0.41     5.23     6.85 1.00     4853     6589
# sigma_condControl          1.47      0.03     1.41     1.52 1.00     9391     8025
# sigma_condIntervention     1.47      0.04     1.39     1.55 1.00     8762     6815
#

# and Tail_ESS are effective sample size measures, and Rhat is the potential
# scale reduction factor on split chains (at convergence, Rhat = 1).
chains_gain <- get_chains(gain_gaussian_flat)

for (l in 1:length(unique(dat$class))) {
  name <- paste0("d_z_", l, "_control")

}

bayestestR::hdi(chains_gain$d_z_mean, ci = 0.95) #95% HDI: [1.07, 1.28]
chains_gain$d_z_sd <- apply(subset(chains_gain, select = c(d_z_1_control:d_z_62_control)), 1, sd)

#Intervention Condition

#Histogram
random <- data.frame(
  cl = rep(1:62, 2),
  d_z = c(
    colMeans(subset(chains_gain, select = c(d_z_1_control:d_z_62_control)), na.rm = TRUE),
    colMeans(subset(chains_gain, select = c(d_z_1_intervention:d_z_62_intervention)), na.rm = TRUE)
  ),
  Condition = c(rep("Control", 62), rep("Intervention", 62)),
  mean = c(rep(d_z_control, 62), rep(d_z_intervention, 62)),
  low = c(rep(d_z_control - d_z_sd_control, 62), rep(d_z_intervention - d_z_sd_intervention, 62)),
  high = c(rep(d_z_control + d_z_sd_control, 62), rep(d_z_intervention + d_z_sd_intervention, 62))
)

random <- random %>% mutate(Condition = as.factor(Condition))
random <- random %>% mutate(Condition = fct_relevel(Condition, "Control", "Intervention"))
  
random %>% ggplot(aes(x = d_z)) + geom_histogram(bins = 70, color = "black", alpha = 0.3, linewidth = .1) + ylab("Frequency") + theme_classic(base_size = size) + scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty(random$d_z, n = 8)) + xlab(TeX("Cohen's $d_z$ for each Class via Partial Pooling")) + geom_vline(aes(xintercept = mean), linetype="dashed", linewidth = 1) + geom_segment(data = random, aes(x = low, xend = high, y = 0, yend = 0), inherit.aes = FALSE, colour = "black", linewidth = 2.5) + facet_wrap(~Condition) + scale_fill_grey() + scale_color_grey() + labs(color='') 

#Learning per class
random %>% ggplot(aes(x = Condition, y = d_z, group = cl)) + geom_point(alpha = 0.3) + geom_path(alpha = 0.3, linetype = "dashed") + scale_fill_grey() + scale_color_grey() + labs(color='') + xlab("Condition") + ylab(TeX("Cohen's $d_z$ ")) + theme_classic(base_size = size)
```

```{r}
# Formula: post - pre ~ 0 + cond + (0 + cond | class) 
#          sigma ~ 0 + cond + (0 + cond | class)

# ~class (Number of levels: 62)

# sd(condControl)                                   2.39      0.28     1.90     2.99 1.00     3543     5965

# sd(sigma_condControl)                             0.08      0.04     0.00     0.16 1.00     2437     3260
```

```{r}
# cor(condControl,condIntervention)                 0.71      0.20     0.24     0.98 1.00     2464     3830
# cor(sigma_condControl,sigma_condIntervention)    -0.07      0.57    -0.96     0.93 1.00     6648     7156
# 
# Regression Coefficients:
#                        Estimate Est.Error l-95% CI u-95% CI Rhat Bulk_ESS Tail_ESS
# condControl                5.82      0.36     5.11     6.51 1.00     2562     4038
# condIntervention           6.02      0.41     5.20     6.81 1.00     4793     6125
# sigma_condControl          1.44      0.03     1.38     1.50 1.00     8915     7393
# sigma_condIntervention     1.45      0.04     1.37     1.53 1.00    11004     7771
# 
# Further Distributional Parameters:

# nu    41.91     15.90    19.45    80.64 1.00    14687     6883
# 
# Draws were sampled using sampling(NUTS). For each parameter, Bulk_ESS
# and Tail_ESS are effective sample size measures, and Rhat is the potential
# scale reduction factor on split chains (at convergence, Rhat = 1).
chains_gain <- get_chains(gain_t_flat)

for (l in 1:length(unique(dat$class))) {
  name <- paste0("d_z_", l, "_control")
  name_control <- paste0("r_class.", l, ".condControl.")
  name_sigma_control <- paste0("r_class__sigma.", l, ".condControl.")
  
  chains_gain[[name]] <- (chains_gain$b_condControl + chains_gain[names(chains_gain) == name_control])/sqrt(exp(2 * chains_gain$b_sigma_condControl + 2 * chains_gain[names(chains_gain) == name_sigma_control] + 2 * chains_gain$sd_class__sigma_condControl^2) + chains_gain$sd_class__condControl^2)
}

}
```

##Simulation Study
###Monte-Carlo Run
```{r}
library(doFuture)
library(doRNG)
library(progressr)

#Global Simulation Settings
set.seed(0)
registerDoFuture()
plan(multisession, workers = 6)
handlers(global = TRUE)
handlers("cli")            # Alternatively use "progress" or "txtprogressbar" if desired
n_rep <- 120
all_results <- list()

beta_0 <- 5.85        # Control condition mean
beta_1 <- 6.05        # Treatment difference mean
  
gamma_0 <- 1.50      # Control condition log-sigma baseline sd
gamma_1 <- 1.50    # Treatment condition log-sigma baseline sd
        
sd_0 <- 2.40          # Control condition random location standard deviation
sd_1 <- 2.00          # Treatment condition random location standard deviation
rho_u <- 0.70         # Correlation random location slopes 
  
sd_sigma_0 <- 0.08    # Control condition random scale standard deviation
sd_sigma_1 <- 0.07  # Treatment condition random scale standard deviation
rho_v <- -0.10        # Correlation random scale slopes 

J_classes <- 62

loop <- function(r){
  # Generate correlated cluster-level location deviations (u_0j, u_1j)
  Sigma_u <- matrix(
    c(sd_0^2, rho_u * sd_0 * sd_1,
      rho_u * sd_0 * sd_1, sd_1^2
      ), nrow = 2)
  
  u_deviations <- MASS::mvrnorm(J_classes, mu = c(0, 0), Sigma = Sigma_u)
  
  # Generate correlated cluster-level scale deviations (v_0j, v_1j)
  Sigma_v <- matrix(
    c(sd_sigma_0^2, rho_v * sd_sigma_0 * sd_sigma_1,
      rho_v * sd_sigma_0 * sd_sigma_1, sd_sigma_1^2
    ), nrow = 2)
  
  v_deviations <- MASS::mvrnorm(J_classes, mu = c(0, 0), Sigma = Sigma_v)

  clust <- tibble(
    clus = 1:J_classes,
    u_0j = u_deviations[, 1],
    u_1j = u_deviations[, 2],
    v_0j = v_deviations[, 1],
    v_1j = v_deviations[, 2]
  )
    
  clust$n_j <- rpois(J_classes, lambda = 22) %>% pmax(10)

  # Expand to individual observations (within-cluster randomization)
  df <- clust %>%
    uncount(n_j) %>%
    group_by(clus) %>%
    mutate(
    cond = rbinom(length(clus), size = 1, prob = 438/1377),

    # Compute individual parameters using cell-means structure
    mu_ij = if_else(cond == 0, beta_0 + u_0j, beta_1 + u_1j),
    log_sigma_ij = if_else(cond == 0, gamma_0 + v_0j, gamma_1 + v_1j),
    sigma_ij = exp(log_sigma_ij),
    y = rnorm(length(clus), mean = mu_ij, sd = sigma_ij)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
    
  df <- df %>% dplyr::select(clus, cond, y)
  
  # Calculate true population hybrid SMD 
  var_total_0_cl <- sd_0^2 + exp(2 * gamma_0 + 2 * sd_sigma_0^2)
  var_total_1_cl <- sd_1^2 + exp(2 * gamma_1 + 2 * sd_sigma_1^2)
  true_smd_0 <- beta_0 / sqrt(var_total_0_cl)
  true_smd_1 <- beta_1 / sqrt(var_total_1_cl)
  
  df <- df %>% mutate(
    cond = as.factor(cond)
  )
  
  # nrow(df %>% filter(cond == 0)) #939
  # nrow(df %>% filter(cond == 1)) #438
  # 
  # df %>% ggplot(aes(x = cond, y = y)) + geom_violin() + geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, alpha = 1/5) + stat_summary(fun = mean, colour = "black", geom = "point", shape = 18, size = 6, show.legend = FALSE) + theme_classic(base_size = font)
  
  # Fit full model
  fit_full <- brm(bf(
      y ~ 0 + cond + (0 + cond|clus),
      sigma ~ 0 + cond + (0 + cond|clus), decomp = "QR"),
    family = gaussian(),
    data = df ,
    warmup = 2000,
    iter = 4000,
    chains = 3,
    cores = parallel::detectCores (),
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.99 , max_treedepth = 15),
    backend = "cmdstanr",
    stan_model_args = list(stanc_options = list("O1")),
    seed = 0,
    normalize = FALSE,
    silent = 2,
    refresh = 0
  )

  # pp_check(fit_full, type = "dens_overlay", ndraws = 100)
  # pp_check(fit_full, type = "dens_overlay_grouped", ndraws = 100, group = "cond")
  # pp_check(fit_full, type = "dens_overlay_grouped", ndraws = 100, group = "clus")
  #
  # pp_check(fit_full, type = "pit_ecdf", ndraws = 100)
  # pp_check(fit_full, type = "pit_ecdf_grouped", ndraws = 100, group = "cond")
  # pp_check(fit_full, type = "pit_ecdf_grouped", ndraws = 100, group = "clus")
  #
  # pp_check(fit_full, type = "error_scatter_avg")
  # pp_check(fit_full, type = "error_scatter_avg_grouped", group = "cond")
  # pp_check(fit_full, type = "error_scatter_avg_grouped", group = "clus")
  #
  # pp_check(fit_full, type = "loo_pit_ecdf", ndraws = 100)

  prediction_grid <- expand_grid(
    clus = unique(df$clus),
    cond = unique(df$cond)
  )
  
  draws <- as_draws_df(fit_full)

  cluster_ids <- unique(df$clus) # Extract all unique cluster names

  clusterwise_smd <- lapply(cluster_ids, function(j) {

    name_u_0 <- paste0("r_clus[", j, ",cond0]")
    name_u_1 <- paste0("r_clus[", j, ",cond1]")

    name_v_0  <- paste0("r_clus__sigma[", j, ",cond0]")
    name_v_1 <- paste0("r_clus__sigma[", j, ",cond1]")

    draws %>%
      dplyr::select(
        .draw,
        # Fixed effects
        beta_0 = b_cond0,
        beta_1 = b_cond1,
        gamma_0 = b_sigma_cond0,
        gamma_1 = b_sigma_cond1,
        # Global random standard deviations
        sd_0    = sd_clus__cond0,
        sd_1    = sd_clus__cond1,
        sd_sigma_0  = sd_clus__sigma_cond0,
        sd_sigma_1  = sd_clus__sigma_cond1,
        # Cluster-specific random effects
        u_0      = all_of(name_u_0),
        u_1     = all_of(name_u_1),
        v_0     = all_of(name_v_0),
        v_1    = all_of(name_v_1)
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        clus = j, # Track cluster

        V_0 = sd_0^2 + exp(2 * gamma_0 + 2 * sd_sigma_0^2 + 2 * v_0),
        V_1 = sd_1^2 + exp(2 * gamma_1 + 2 * sd_sigma_1^2 + 2 * v_1),
        smd_0 = (beta_0 + u_0) / sqrt(V_0),
        smd_1 = (beta_1 + u_1) / sqrt(V_1)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::select(clus, .draw, smd_0, smd_1)
      }) %>%
        bind_rows()

  mean_smd_per_draw <- clusterwise_smd %>%
    group_by(.draw) %>%
    dplyr::summarize(
      mean_smd_0 = mean(smd_0),
      mean_smd_1 = mean(smd_1),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  summary_0 <- mean_smd_per_draw %>%
    mean_hdci(mean_smd_0) %>%
    mutate(model = "cond_0", true_val = true_smd_0) %>% dplyr::rename(estimate = mean_smd_0)
    
  summary_1 <- mean_smd_per_draw %>%
    mean_hdci(mean_smd_1) %>%
    mutate(model = "cond_1", true_val = true_smd_1) %>% dplyr::rename(estimate = mean_smd_1)
    
  p(message = sprintf("Rep %d", r))
     
  #Summarise results
  bind_rows(summary_0, summary_1) 
}

with_progress({
  p <- progressor(steps = n_rep)
  suppressWarnings(estimates_d_z <- foreach(r = 1:n_rep, .combine = 'rbind', .packages = "progressr") %dorng% loop(r))
})

save(estimates_d_z, file = "estimates_d_z.RObject")
```
